coverage.description: Coverage in %, alternatively, min_alignment_length can be used
coverage.title: Coverage

min_alignment_length.description: Number of nucleotides for alignment, alternatively, coverage can be used
min_alignment_length.title: Min Alignment Length

-query_loc.description: Location on the query sequence in 1-based offsets (Format: start-stop).
-query_loc.title: -Query Loc

-strand.description: Query strand(s) to search against database/subject. Choice of both, minus, or plus.
-strand.title: -Strand

-evalue.description: Expectation value (E) threshold for saving hits. Default = 10 (1000 for blastn-short)
-evalue.title: -Evalue

-num_descriptions.description: Number of database sequences to show one-line descriptions for.
-num_descriptions.title: -Num Descriptions

-num_alignments.description: Number of database sequences to show alignments for.
-num_alignments.title: -Num Alignments

-soft_masking.description: Apply filtering locations as soft masks (i.e., only for finding initial matches).
-soft_masking.title: -Soft Masking

-lcase_masking.description: Use lower case filtering in query and subject sequence(s).
-lcase_masking.title: -Lcase Masking

-db_soft_mask.description: Filtering algorithm ID to apply to the BLAST database as soft mask (i.e., only for finding initial matches).
-db_soft_mask.title: -Db Soft Mask

-db_hard_mask.description: Filtering algorithm ID to apply to the BLAST database as hard mask (i.e., sequence is masked for all phases of search).
-db_hard_mask.title: -Db Hard Mask

-max_hsps.description: Set maximum number of HSPs per subject sequence to save for each query.
-max_hsps.title: -Max Hsps

-culling_limit.description: If the query range of a hit is enveloped by that of at least this many higher-scoring hits, delete the hit
-culling_limit.title: -Culling Limit

-best_hit_overhang.description: Best Hit algorithm overhang value (recommended value: 0.1).
-best_hit_overhang.title: -Best Hit Overhang

-best_hit_score_edge.description: Best Hit algorithm score edge value (recommended value: 0.1)
-best_hit_score_edge.title: -Best Hit Score Edge

-subject_besthit.description: Turn on best hit per subject sequence.
-subject_besthit.title: -Subject Besthit

-max_target_seqs.description: Maximum number of aligned sequences to keep.
-max_target_seqs.title: -Max Target Seqs

-template_type.description: Discontiguous MegaBLAST template type. Allowed values are coding, optimal and coding_and_optimal.
-template_type.title: -Template Type

-searchsp.description: Effective length of the search space.
-searchsp.title: -Searchsp

-xdrop_ungap.description: X-dropoff value (in bits) for ungapped extensions.
-xdrop_ungap.title: -Xdrop Ungap

-xdrop_gap.description: X-dropoff value (in bits) for preliminary gapped extensions.
-xdrop_gap.title: -Xdrop Gap

-xdrop_gap_final.description: X-dropoff value (in bits) for final gapped alignment.
-xdrop_gap_final.title: -Xdrop Gap Final

-min_raw_gapped_score.description: Minimum raw gapped score to keep an alignment in the preliminary gapped and trace-back stages. Normally set based upon expect value.
-min_raw_gapped_score.title: -Min Raw Gapped Score

-window_size.description: Multiple hits window size, use 0 to specify 1-hit algorithm.
-window_size.title: -Window Size

-off_diagonal_range.description: Number of off-diagonals to search for the 2nd hit, use 0 to turn off.
-off_diagonal_range.title: -Off Diagonal Range

search_parameters.description: Parameters for BLASTN searches used in cross-hybridization filtering.

hit_parameters.description: Parameters for filtering BLASTN hits in cross-hybridization searches. Use either coverage or min_alignment_length.

GC_content_min.description: Minimum GC content (in %) for probes. Probes with GC content below this value will be filtered out/rejected.
GC_content_min.title: Gc Content Min

GC_content_max.description: Maximum GC content (in %) for probes. Probes with GC content above this value will be filtered out/rejected.
GC_content_max.title: Gc Content Max

weight.description: Weight assigned in the scoring function.
weight.title: Weight

GC_content_min.description: Minimum GC content (in %) for probes. Probes with GC content below this value will be filtered out/rejected.
GC_content_min.title: Gc Content Min

GC_content_opt.description: Optimal GC content (in %) for target probes. Used in scoring to prioritize probes closer to this value.
GC_content_opt.title: Gc Content Opt

GC_content_max.description: Maximum GC content (in %) for probes. Probes with GC content above this value will be filtered out/rejected.
GC_content_max.title: Gc Content Max

homopolymeric_base_n.description: minimum number of nucleotides to consider it a homopolymeric run per base

n_sets.description: Number of oligo sets to generate per region. Multiple sets allow for redundancy and selection of the best-performing set based on scoring criteria.
n_sets.title: N Sets

set_size_min.description: Minimum size (number of probes) required for each oligo set. Sets with fewer probes than this value will be rejected, and regions that cannot generate sets meeting this minimum will be removed. Regions with less oligos will be filtered out and stored in regions_with_insufficient_oligos_for_db_probes.
set_size_min.title: Set Size Min

set_size_opt.description: Optimal size (number of probes) for each oligo set. The set selection algorithm will attempt to generate sets of this size, but may produce sets with fewer probes if constraints cannot be met.
set_size_opt.title: Set Size Opt

distance_between_target_probes.description: How much overlap should be allowed between oligos, e.g. if oligos can overlap x bases choose -x, if oligos can be next to one another choose 0, if oligos should be x bases apart choose x.
distance_between_target_probes.title: Distance Between Target Probes

n_attempts_graph.description: Number of randomized graph attempts. In each attempt, a fraction of nodes is randomly removed from the compatibility graph to create diversity; more attempts increase diversity at the cost of runtime.
n_attempts_graph.title: N Attempts Graph

n_attempts_clique_enum.description: Maximum number of cliques enumerated per graph attempt. Limits how many cliques are explored before stopping enumeration for the current graph.
n_attempts_clique_enum.title: N Attempts Clique Enum

diversification_fraction.description: Fraction of oligos to remove from the graph per attempt to create diversity in the set selection.
diversification_fraction.title: Diversification Fraction

jaccard_opt.description: Optimal maximum Jaccard overlap allowed between selected sets. Lower values enforce more diversity between sets.
jaccard_opt.title: Jaccard Opt

jaccard_step.description: Step size used to relax the Jaccard constraint when not enough sets are found.
jaccard_step.title: Jaccard Step

isoform_consensus.description: Threshold for isoform consensus filtering in %. Probes with isoform consensus values below this threshold will be filtered out. This ensures that selected probes target sequences that are conserved across multiple transcript isoforms.
isoform_consensus.title: Isoform Consensus

weight.description: Weight assigned in the scoring function.
weight.title: Weight

action.description: Action for variant-overlapping oligos: 'flag' (mark only) or 'filter' (exclude).
action.title: Action

prohibited_sequences.description: The sequences to prohibit in the oligos. If an oligo contains any of these sequences, it will be filtered out.
prohibited_sequences.title: Prohibited Sequences

kmer_abundance_threshold.description: The maximum abundance of a k-mer allowed. If a k-mer has an abundance greater than this threshold, all oligos containing this k-mer will be filtered out. This is a dictionary with the k-mer length as the key and the threshold as the value.
kmer_abundance_threshold.title: Kmer Abundance Threshold

read_length_bias.description: Number of nucleotides from the 5' end of probes to check for read length bias. Probes where the first N bases match exactly with other probes are removed to prevent sequencing read length biases.
read_length_bias.title: Read Length Bias

T.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius at which to evaluate secondary structure formation (free energy calculation). Secondary structures that form at this temperature can interfere with probe binding.
T.title: T

thr_DG.description: DeltaG threshold (in kcal/mol) for secondary structure stability. Probes with secondary structures having deltaG values more negative (more stable) than this threshold will be filtered out.
thr_DG.title: Thr Dg

max_len_selfcomplement.description: Maximum allowable length of self-complementary sequences. Probes with longer self-complementary regions can form hairpins and reduce hybridization efficiency.
max_len_selfcomplement.title: Max Len Selfcomplement

file_region_ids.description: File with a list the genes used to generate the probe sequences, leave empty if all the genes are used. For examples, see 'data/genes'.
file_region_ids.title: File Region Ids

probe_length_min.description: Minimum length (in nucleotides) for oligo sequences.
probe_length_min.title: Probe Length Min

probe_length_max.description: Maximum length (in nucleotides) for probe sequences.
probe_length_max.title: Probe Length Max

probe_split_region.description: Minimum number of bases covering the exon junction, i.e. the oligo should contain at least x bases upstream/downstream of the junction.
probe_split_region.title: Probe Split Region

targeted_exons.description: List of exon identifiers that should be preferentially targeted by probes, e.g. ['1', '2', '3']. Only probes in these exons are kept.
targeted_exons.title: Targeted Exons

weight.description: Weight assigned in the scoring function.
weight.title: Weight

targeted_exons.description: List of exon identifiers that should be preferentially targeted by probes, e.g. ['1', '2', '3']. Probes overlapping these exons receive higher scores.
targeted_exons.title: Targeted Exons

DMSOfactor.description: How much Tm should decrease per percent DMSO
DMSOfactor.title: Dmsofactor

fmdfactor.description: How much Tm should decrease per percent formamide
fmdfactor.title: Fmdfactor

fmdmethod.description: Tm = Tm - factor(%formamide) (Default); Tm = Tm + (0.453(f(GC)) - 2.88) x [formamide]
fmdmethod.title: Fmdmethod

enabled.description: Should chem correction be used in the calculation of the melting temperature?
enabled.title: Enabled

enabled.description: Should chem correction be used in the calculation of the melting temperature?
enabled.title: Enabled

Tm_min.description: Minimum melting temperature (Tm) in degrees Celsius for probes. Probes with calculated Tm below this value will be filtered out.
Tm_min.title: Tm Min

Tm_max.description: Maximum melting temperature (Tm) in degrees Celsius for target probes. Probes with calculated Tm above this value will be filtered out. This value is also used as the optimal Tm target in probe scoring.
Tm_max.title: Tm Max

check.description: Checks if the sequence is valid for the given method.
check.title: Check

strict.description: Do not allow base characters or neighbor duplex keys (e.g. 'AT/NA') that could not or not unambiguously be evaluated for the respective method.
strict.title: Strict

c_seq.description: Complementary sequence. The sequence of the template/target in 3'->5' direction. c_seq is necessary for mismatch correction and dangling-ends correction. Both corrections will automatically be applied if mismatches or dangling ends are present.
c_seq.title: C Seq

shift.description: Shift of the primer/probe sequence on the template/target sequence. The shift parameter is necessary to align seq and c_seq if they have different lengths or if they should have dangling ends.
shift.title: Shift

selfcomp.description: Is the sequence self-complementary? If 'True' the primer is thought binding to itself, thus dnac2 is not considered.
selfcomp.title: Selfcomp

imm_table.description: Thermodynamic values for internal mismatches, may include insosine mismatches.
imm_table.title: Imm Table

dnac1.description: Concentration of the higher concentrated strand [nM].
dnac1.title: Dnac1

dnac2.description: Concentration of the lower concentrated strand [nM].
dnac2.title: Dnac2

method.description: Correction method to be applied. Methods 1-4 correct Tm, method 5 corrects deltaS, methods 6 and 7 correct 1/Tm.
method.title: Method

enabled.description: Should salt correction be used in the calculation of the melting temperature?
enabled.title: Enabled

enabled.description: Should salt correction be used in the calculation of the melting temperature?
enabled.title: Enabled

weight.description: Weight assigned in the scoring function.
weight.title: Weight

Tm_min.description: Minimum melting temperature (Tm) in degrees Celsius for probes. Probes with calculated Tm below this value will be filtered out.
Tm_min.title: Tm Min

Tm_opt.description: Optimal melting temperature (Tm) for oligos in degrees Celsius. Used in scoring to prioritize probes closer to this value.
Tm_opt.title: Tm Opt

Tm_max.description: Maximum melting temperature (Tm) in degrees Celsius for target probes. Probes with calculated Tm above this value will be filtered out. This value is also used as the optimal Tm target in probe scoring.
Tm_max.title: Tm Max

description:
This Model overrides the default ODT Model of the Oligo-Seq pipeline, so
we can inject our custom genomic region generator models. Adding to that it removes attributes like
the general section of the OligoDesignerConfig, so these option do not get exposed to the user.
title: OligoSeqProbeDesignerConfigFrontEnd
